checkpoints.title: First domain or encoding checkpoint
checkpoints.contract: The small immutable first checkpoint described in its source; no later service features are claimed.

checkpoints.title: Bounded frame codec
checkpoints.contract: A synchronous byte-stream codec accepts UTF-8 frames of1..1024 bytes without control characters; distinguishes clean EOF from truncated input; bounds allocation before reading payload. No TCP listener, Tokio task, broadcast, or shutdown behavior exists in this milestone.

checkpoints.title: Complete reference implementation
checkpoints.contract: The current complete reference source with its documented limits, fixtures, tests and operational requirements. Database tests remain explicit opt-in checks where applicable.
